name: Murderers VS Sheriffs
creator: MVS Duels Community
redeem: Launch Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels on Roblox and wait for the lobby to load.
Click the Codes button in the top-right corner of the lobby screen.
Click the Enter Code Here box in the window that opens.
Type or paste the code exactly as written and press the CLAIM! button.
notes:
Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels is a team PvP game run by the MVS Duels Community group. Each round pits murderers armed with knives against sheriffs armed with guns in 1v1, 2v2, 3v3 or 4v4 matches, and the last side standing takes the round. Rounds are short, so the appeal is sharpening your aim and reactions against real players.

Coins buy cosmetic knife and gun skins, which is what codes usually cover: the current code gives the 1B Knife for passing one billion visits, and an older one gives 1,000 coins. The developers post new codes in the codes channel of their Discord server, usually around visit milestones and updates.

expired.reason: no longer listed by the game

faq.q: What does the 1BVISITS code give in Murderers VS Sheriffs?
faq.a: 1BVISITS gives you the 1B Knife, a free knife skin. The developers added it to celebrate the game passing one billion visits.

faq.q: Where do the Murderers VS Sheriffs developers post new codes?
faq.a: The developers post new codes in the codes channel of their Discord server, usually around visit milestones and updates. The current code is also listed in the game's Roblox description.

faq.q: What do code rewards and coins get you in Murderers VS Sheriffs?
faq.a: Codes usually give knife or gun skins, or coins. Coins buy cosmetic knife and gun skins, so these rewards change how your weapons look, not how they perform.

tips: As a sheriff, keep some distance and aim carefully, since your gun is strongest at range. As a murderer, use cover to close the gap before you strike.
Practise in 1v1 matches first. With only one opponent, you can focus on your aim and reaction time before trying team modes.
In 3v3 and 4v4 rounds, stay close to your teammates. A player on their own is easy to pick off, especially by a group.
Rounds are quick, so do not dwell on a loss. Think about what went wrong and try a different approach in the next round.
useRewards: 1BVISITS gives the 1B Knife, a skin that marks the game passing one billion visits. Skins only change how your weapon looks, so there is nothing to time. Claim it while the code is still live, because milestone codes do not stay around forever. When a code gives coins instead, save them for a knife or gun skin you really like rather than the first one you can afford.
